name: postgresql-inspection
purpose: Optional schema and query investigation for projects that require PostgreSQL.
setup_steps: Select, license-review, and pin one PostgreSQL MCP implementation
Create or select a database role whose privileges enforce read-only access
Provide its DSN through AIDE_POSTGRES_DSN locally
health_check: MCP initialize and tools/list; database reads are separate and require target confirmation
corrective_action: Pin a reviewed server and use a database role whose privileges enforce read-only inspection.
permissions: Schema/query inspection only; prompt instructions are not a database authorization boundary.
